searchText: I don't know how many clients are already doing this: https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-APIs/pull/545 We currently implemented a change where we always call with committeeIndex set to 0. Which means that we call it once even if we have validators in different committees We had a committee grouping optimization already pre-electra in Lodestar and only called this api once with index 0, then on the vc side mutated the data with the correct index before signing and submitting the attestations. As per spec the bn should already ignore the index and always set it to 0 > For `slot`s in Electra and later, this AttestationData must have a `committee_index` of 0. we can still add the note from your PR though i think it worth it in case on the BN side someone uses that param to do something else before putting 0 in the attestationData so it will be well known that the param wont be indicative of the actual committee

We had a committee grouping optimization already pre-electra in Lodestar and only called this api once with index 0, then on the vc side mutated the data with the correct index before signing and submitting the attestations.

As per spec the bn should already ignore the index and always set it to 0
> For `slot`s in Electra and later, this AttestationData must have a `committee_index` of 0.

we can still add the note from your PR though
